title: Advertising jobs with Bob Lyons and other bands
summary: Foster played drums on advertising trucks for dances, mostly with Bob Lyons and with Rainey, working weekends.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals

blocks.x: I was gonna ask you about the advertising job. You say you played advertising jobs. Who did you play? What band did you play with?

Well I wouldn't say like it was regular. But just like you say you played, you played with him maybe like this Saturday, maybe Saturday and Sunday. You know? Sure.
